reason: A web UI plugin that audibly notifies users about completed tasks and events requiring human attention, with configurable sounds and per-workspace settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可按工作区配置的任务完成提示音和人工关注事件提醒音。
summaries.en: Adds configurable completion and attention sounds to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, including per-workspace notification settings.

capabilities: Detects task completion and human-attention events in the web UI
Plays synthesized, text-to-speech, or uploaded audio notifications
Provides configurable global, workspace-specific, and event-specific sound settings
Stores notification configuration in browser localStorage
